candidates.name: Block Iron & Supply Company (Milwaukee branch)
candidates.partition_evidence: Its Division 10 section lists toilet partitions and toilet accessories and says 'we also provide delivery and installation services for our customers', on projects up to large schools and hospitals.
red_flags: Division 10 distributor that sells partitions itself (buy-around risk)
Brand logos appear on the homepage but aren't tied to partitions
The page lists a Division 10 email (Div10@blockiron.com) whose link points to a personal address, so I listed the Milwaukee counter-sales email instead
candidates.reason: Commercial Division 8/10 distributor with a Milwaukee-area branch that supplies and installs toilet partitions. Strong on installing, but it is also a supplier competing with us.

license.name: Block Iron & Supply Company (Milwaukee branch)
license.registry: City of Milwaukee DNS Licensed Contractors list; Wisconsin DSPS license lookup
license.note: Based in New Berlin. No state license applies to commercial partition installation. The city registry blocked automated access (403), and the DFI entity search also returned 403. No record was checked.

candidates.name: Marz and Associates
candidates.partition_evidence: Calls itself a 'Division 10 specialty contractor serving all of Wisconsin' that sells and installs bathroom partitions. Its project photos show a commercial men's restroom with partitions and a school restroom with privacy screens.
red_flags: Based about 120 miles from Milwaukee, at the edge of the regional range
Sells partitions as well as installing them (buy-around risk)
No partition brand named
candidates.reason: Commercial Division 10 contractor that installs toilet partitions and says it serves all of Wisconsin, but it's based far away in Shawano.

license.name: Marz and Associates
license.registry: City of Milwaukee DNS Licensed Contractors list (https://city.milwaukee.gov/DNS/permits/LicensedContractors); Wisconsin DSPS license lookup
license.note: Based in Shawano. Wisconsin has no state license for commercial partition installation (DSPS credentials cover 1-2 family dwelling contractors and trades). The Milwaukee DNS licensed-contractors page returned 403 and the city rule is a low-confidence phone-call item, so no record was checked. Search results suggest Milwaukee has no general contractor license for commercial interior work, but no official page confirmed it. Confirm with DNS (414-286-8210 per search snippet, not read on an official page).

candidates.name: Prestige Distribution, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Sells partitions in many materials and offers field measuring and installation through a contractor network it says has installed 'in every state'.
red_flags: National partition distributor competing with Next Partitions (strong buy-around risk)
Installs through a contractor network, not its own crews
Doesn't name Wisconsin or Milwaukee
candidates.reason: It installs partitions and is about 70 miles away, but it is a competing distributor that subcontracts installs and doesn't say it serves Wisconsin.

license.name: Prestige Distribution, Inc.
license.registry: Wisconsin DSPS (state) and City of Milwaukee Department of Neighborhood Services (local); no online registry checked
license.note: Wisconsin has no state contractor license for commercial work. The DSPS Dwelling Contractor credential covers only one- and two-family dwellings (from the repo's research/state-licensing/states.json). Per the repo's research/local-rules/cities.json, Milwaukee licenses electrical, plumbing and home improvement contractors but has no general contractor license for commercial interior work. That rule is low-confidence because the city site could not be opened, so confirm by phone with Milwaukee DNS. The firm is based in Northbrook, IL (https://prestigedistribution.com/), and the site mentions no Wisconsin license.

candidates.name: LaForce (Milwaukee office)
candidates.partition_evidence: The Building Specialties page lists toilet partitions in several materials, shower and dressing compartments, and partition hardware for all manufacturers. The install page covers commercial door and frame installation only. No page says LaForce installs partitions.
red_flags: Supplies toilet partitions itself (buy-around risk)
Large commercial door and hardware distributor; partition installation not shown
Brands listed are door-hardware partners, not partition makers
candidates.reason: LaForce is a commercial Division 10 and door supplier with a Milwaukee office in Menomonee Falls and its own install crews for doors and frames. It sells toilet partitions, but no page shows it installing them, so this is unproven. It is also a competing partitions seller.

candidates.name: Solid Partitions
candidates.partition_evidence: It manufactures its own partitions with custom CNC work, in headrail-braced, floor-to-ceiling and ceiling-hung styles, and supplies them to architects and designers. Its only featured project (Lake Country DockHounds) says it 'manufactured' the partitions, not that it installed them. The site offers installation instructions only.
red_flags: Manufactures and sells its own partitions (direct competitor and buy-around risk)
No installation service shown
candidates.reason: Solid Partitions is a local partition manufacturer and supplier, not an installer. Its site shows no installation service, and it competes directly with Next Partitions on product.

candidates.name: Best Specialties, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: It supplies Division 10 products: toilet partition hardware, washroom accessories, fire extinguishers and cabinets, and lockers. It offers a downloadable partition installation instructions sheet. No installation service is stated.
red_flags: Supplier of Division 10 products and partition hardware; no installation service shown
No company email on the site
candidates.reason: Best Specialties is a Milwaukee supplier of Division 10 specialties and partition hardware. Neither page read says it installs partitions or accessories, so there is no evidence it does installation work.
